reuse.why: Changes only the existing isNonWorkingDay predicate, which every holiday-aware path already goes through.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the MM-DD match is added once in the single holiday predicate.

placement.why: The holiday-matching rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the tree defines non-working days.

scope.why: Predicate, a type comment, one test and a release note; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Small, readable change in one definition; the format is documented on the type.
